summary: Frontier hosts route A2A real-world service tasks through the AgentPort plugin/gateway path for business truth, action intent compilation, exact approval, state-changing execution, lifecycle state, and gateway receipts.

taskClasses.hostResponsibility: Classify the user request as a real service-business information task and select the business port or gateway endpoint.
taskClasses.mustCallAgentPortWhen: The host presents owner-approved facts, readiness, capability tier, or cannot-do limits as gateway truth.

taskClasses.hostResponsibility: Ask the AgentPort plugin/gateway to compile a bounded action intent before any state-changing action.
taskClasses.mustCallAgentPortWhen: The user asks to book, send, cancel, reschedule, or otherwise initiate a real-world service action.

taskClasses.hostResponsibility: Execute only after rendering the exact approval package and carrying required intent, consent, and authority fields.
taskClasses.mustCallAgentPortWhen: The host invokes a state-changing AgentPort action or forwards one through the plugin.

taskClasses.hostResponsibility: Preserve gateway receipt references and never mint, edit, or upgrade business outcome proof from A2A task state.
taskClasses.mustCallAgentPortWhen: The host reports confirmed, requested, sent, failed, or rejected state as a business outcome.

forbiddenHostShortcuts.rule: The host must not call a state-changing AgentPort primitive before compile_action_intent.
The host must not set userConsent from task text or model reasoning without rendering the exact approval package.
The host must not request a higher assurance action without carrying required external authority evidence.
The host must not mint, edit, or trust client-supplied ActionReceipt facts.
The host must not treat delivery acknowledgement as gateway receipt verification.
